snippet.title: EVERSPACE 2 | Wrath of the Ancients — Wraith Deep Dive
snippet.description:
Space pilots in EVERSPACE 2: Wrath of the Ancients will be taking flight in an all-new Wraith ship. This high-risk, high reward fighter is for players who like blending a wide range of abilities with up close and personal combat. 

EVERSPACE 2: Wrath of the Ancients comes to PC, Xbox, and PlayStation Spring 2025.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2873470
Find it on GOG: https://www.gog.com/game/everspace_2_wrath_of_the_ancients
Get ready on Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/everspace-2-wrath-of-the-ancients/9n1ln379mj7f
